final_functional_matrix.reason: Concurrent correctness jobs; use only output, allocation and memory assertions.

diagnostic_sources.verify-final-matrix.py:
import json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=json.loads((root/'matrix-results.json').read_text())
outputs=[]
for row in rows:
 for repeat in range(3):
  seed=17 if row['measured'] else [0,17,0xffffffffffffffff][repeat]
  run=subprocess.run([str(root/'final/runtime-matrix'),row['shape'],str(row['size']),row['operation'],str(row['ops']),str(seed)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  assert not run.stderr,run.stderr
  result=json.loads(run.stdout)
  expected=row['samples']['baseline'][0 if row['measured'] else repeat]
  assert all(result[k]==expected[k] for k in ['checksum','order']), (row,result,expected)
  outputs.append({'shape':row['shape'],'size':row['size'],'operation':row['operation'],'seed':seed,'result':result})
 if len(outputs)%60==0:print(len(outputs),'passed',flush=True)
(root/'final-matrix-correctness.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timing_valid':False,'reason':'Concurrent correctness jobs; use only output, allocation and memory assertions.','cases':outputs},indent=2)+'\n')
print('COMPLETE',len(outputs),'matched baseline outputs',flush=True)
